summary: The Elemental Planes are the primal foundations of reality. Each embodies a pure, unfiltered force of nature, ruled by ancient beings of immense power.

events: The Elemental Planes formed first, establishing the cosmic bedrock.
Fire, Water, Earth, and Air stabilized the fabric of reality.
Outer Planes formed around the elemental core.
Mortals first glimpsed planar energies through arcane experimentation.
Planar breaches exposed Norrath to elemental forces.
Mortals invaded the Elemental Planes during the Planes of Power era.
Elemental balance destabilized, affecting all realms.
